_doc: GRAVELIGHT UI kit data (UPDATE 05 section 7, DECISIONS T-096), read by MenuKit. fonts: one face per role, each a bundled file under assets/third_party/google_fonts (OFL / Apache, see their SOURCE.txt) with the system-font fallback MenuKit uses only when the file fails to load; `weight` picks an axis value on a variable font. scale: the type scale, px on the 1920x1080 canvas (window/stretch keeps it; every Label / Button in gravelight/ui is sized by a key here or snapped to the nearest `steps` value by MenuKit.px). outline: the dark outline + drop shadow kinds that make text read on snow and in the dark (size, rgba; shadow = [dx, dy, alpha]); `paper` is the ledger pages (ink on paper: none). hud: the grid every HUD element hangs on: margin = [x, y] px from the screen edge, safe_frac = the fraction of the viewport the margin never goes under (ultrawide / TV safe area), the rest are the offsets between the pieces. crosshair: hip ticks (px; thickness in physical pixels, snapped so lines never blur) and how far moving opens them. hitmarker: the three states' sizes. minimap: the bezel and the open-ground zoom rule (a zone whose bounding box covers more than outdoor_zone_frac of the map's rect is open ground: the view steps out by outdoor_zoom_step levels there). pause_map: the first fit covers the built zones (those under fit_zone_max_frac of the rect); the Grounds stay reachable by zoom / pan and the last zoom is kept for the match.

roles._doc: role -> font key, for MenuKit.text(role, ...) and the theme: stamps and titles are the stencil, headings / buttons / prompts the typewriter, paragraphs the sans, counters the mono.
